definitions: A feature within the Vercel platform that allows users to add and manage comments directly on preview deployments of web projects.
A collaborative tool for providing feedback on web development projects hosted on Vercel, enabling team members to leave comments on specific elements of a preview deployment.
examples: We used Vercel Preview Comments to gather feedback on the new homepage design.
The team found Vercel Preview Comments invaluable for streamlining the review process.
Make sure to check the Vercel Preview Comments for the latest design iterations.
